description:
Replication data for the systematization of knowledge "Security of the Model Context Protocol in Agentic AI Systems" (AI and Security Convergence, manuscript AISC-12351, under review).

The folder v2/ holds the data of the revised manuscript: 215 MCP-specific studies (199 in the conservative set), 112 defense records (102 conservative), and 256 advisories screened for the temporal coverage test (216 eligible), with SHA-256 checksums and a verification script (python v2/verify.py). These files are identical to commit 64bb5a1, which the manuscript cites. Files outside v2/ are the frozen v1 package of the original search (14 November 2026).
